run_ZeroEvenOpTest: run the ZeroEvenOpTest unit tests to verify the ZeroEven Caffe2 operator on CPU and GPU
test_ZeroEven_op_cpu: test the ZeroEven operator on CPU by running _run_zero_even_op with a 1D numpy array
test_ZeroEven_op_gpu: test the ZeroEven operator on GPU by running _run_zero_even_op_gpu with a 1D numpy array
test_non_1D_array_error: test that the ZeroEven operator throws a RuntimeError when given a non-1D array input
test_empty_array_handling: test that the ZeroEven operator correctly handles empty 1D numpy arrays without error
